SUNDAY POT ROAST
Serves 8

INGREDIENTS
3 lb boneless beef chuck roast
2 T vegetable oil
1 large onion, cut in wedges
4 carrots, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces
1 1/2 lb red potatoes, halved
2 c beef broth
1 t dried thyme
2 bay leaves

METHOD
1. Pat the beef chuck roast dry and brown on all sides in the vegetable oil in a Dutch oven.
2. Add the onion, carrots, red potatoes, beef broth, thyme and bay leaves.
3. Cover and roast at 325°F for 3 1/2 hours, until the beef is fork tender.
4. Remove the bay leaves before serving.
